invariants.rationale: partitionPath is required to indicate the partition location to update.
fileId is typically required to identify which file to update.
recordItr must be non-null to iterate over records; null would likely be an error.
If recordItr is used with hasNext(), it must not be null; this follows the code path using recordItr.hasNext().
partitionPath is likely a non-empty string to represent a valid partition; empty would be unusual.
